faq.q: How do I install Blood Strike on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Blood Strike and check the developer is NetEase Games before tapping Install. Google Play only shows the Install button if your phone is compatible. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from NetEase Games and may be altered, so the safest way to play Blood Strike is the official listing.
Yes. Blood Strike is free to play and has no ads. NetEase sells optional in-app purchases from $0.29 to $99.99 per item on Google Play, mainly for skins and the battle pass.

faq.q: Does Blood Strike run on low-end phones?
faq.a: Blood Strike is designed to run on a wide range of Android phones, including mid-range and older devices, with adjustable graphics settings. Google Play lists its requirements as varying by device.

faq.q: What game modes does Blood Strike have?
faq.a: Blood Strike has battle royale, squad-based modes and fast multiplayer modes, with rotating limited-time modes. The latest update adds Nightmare Trial in War Tide, with a nighttime Shutter Island map.

faq.q: Is Blood Strike suitable for kids?
faq.a: Google Play rates Blood Strike Teen for violence and blood. It includes online play with strangers and voice chat, so it's not suitable for younger children.
